chunks: As for those who proclaimed the Imamate of Hasan (peace be upon him)
and said: The Imamate has ended just as Prophethood ended,
their assertion is worthless because of what we have proved through reason and tradition that at no time can the earth remain devoid of an Imam
and that the Imams are twelve
and that the Qaim was born after Hasan
Besides, their statement is invalid from every aspect
and praise be to Allah, they have also become extinct.
ai.seo_question: What is the Shia argument for the continuity of Imamate after Imam Hasan al-Askari?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Tusi refutes the Qata'iyyah (those who claimed the Imamate ended with Hasan al-Askari) by establishing the principle of *hujjiyyat al-'aql* (reason's proof) alongside *shar'* (scripture), asserting the earth is never devoid of an Imam. He validates the birth of the twelfth Imam, Muhammad al-Mahdi, as the continuation of the twelve Imams lineage, noting that the proponents of this view have since perished. This passage serves as a foundational argument for the Occultation (*Ghayba*) and the enduring authority of the Imam in his absence.
